task_intent: Refine Tessera’s discovery, imagination, and listening features with expressive native interfaces and reliable wall feedback.

mobbin.observed: A dark search screen places a single query field above a horizontal category row. Results pair colorful square artwork with a short identity and a clear forward action.
mobbin.applied: One composer with Picture, Cover, and Video scopes; individual remembered drafts; visible source identity retained beside the finished artwork.

mobbin.observed: A compact search field and scope tabs precede results. Each result gives the title stronger emphasis than the creator and other metadata.
mobbin.applied: Scope-specific prompts and examples, a restrained artist/source line, and a strong artwork title hierarchy.

primary.title: Apple Human Interface Guidelines — Searching
primary.access: Official indexed content inspected; direct page requires JavaScript.
primary.applied: Descriptive placeholders and a visible scope selector clarify exactly what will be searched; drafts survive a change of scope and failed requests.

mobbin.observed: Related songs retain visible artwork and names above a carefully separated Track Information area and one prominent Share Song action.
mobbin.applied: The discovered song remains available while another is identified. Sharing uses metadata, and alternatives are a distinct continuation beneath the principal result.

mobbin.observed: Artwork and track names lead a recommendation section; additional album metadata sits below with generous separation.
mobbin.applied: Large sleeve, then song and artist, with secondary album metadata kept quieter; alternatives never compete with the current identification.

mobbin.observed: The result uses a large visual field, a strong song title with artist immediately below, and a single prominent playback action.
mobbin.applied: The result becomes the page's lead object, with one explicit action to show its sleeve again and honest uncertainty language instead of a decorative percentage.

primary.title: Apple — Shazam User Guide
primary.access: Read the official guide and its identification, saved-song, and sharing navigation.
primary.applied: Identification produces an actionable, shareable result that persists when leaving the screen. Earworm clearly states that it identifies typed clues rather than recording audio.

implementation.phone_wall_parity: The JSON result includes a lossless PNG encoded directly from the processed native RGB frame. The phone displays this composition with nearest-neighbor interpolation; identity and controls sit outside the artwork.
implementation.interaction: No duplicate customization modal. Services links route into the existing Settings destination. A result keeps its stable ID, so showing it again does not spend another inference request.
implementation.reliability: Serialized discovery requests, typed input bounds, per-result wall receipts, host/request-version guards, provider failure states, and frame-ownership-aware expiration. Late search results yield when the user has selected another face.
